subject: Insurance
title: Jennifer Lopez's Famous Asset
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Jennifer Lopez's Famous Asset.

hook.text: Reports claim Jennifer Lopez insured her backside for $27 million.

buildup.text: Celebrities insure body parts that define their brand. A model's face, a dancer's legs, an athlete's knees.

discovery.text: These policies pay if injury, accident, or illness changes the insured feature enough to affect earning potential.

twist.text: Many celebrity body-part insurance stories are publicity stunts. The policies may be real, but the leaks are strategic.

climax.text: Body-part insurance blurs the line between risk management and marketing.

punchline.text: Insure a body part, make headlines. Coverage meets marketing.

quiz.question: Why are celebrity body-part insurance stories often publicized?
options: They double as publicity and marketing strategies
